'''0.20f''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that improved synchronization when the system is under stress.

==Changelog==
* Synchronization for players with big ping considerably improved
* Synchronization on low-end computers and low performance improved
* Synchronization under a large number of active actions by player improved
